lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the five gill slits, arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows with approximately 4-6 spots per vertical column in the primary viewing area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity cross the horizontal carinae, creating a checkerboard-like lattice where the circular blobs are centered within the darker interstices of the grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high (top of ridge) to low (shadowed trough below).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant semicircular excision/notch on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, featuring irregular edges and high-luminance white exposed tissue at the innermost point of the trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least two Echeneidae (remora) individuals: one positioned anterior to the pectoral fin near the ventral-lateral margin and one swimming near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
